settings.description: Player run speed multiplier. 1.0 = vanilla MP (too fast for coop). 0.6 = a calmer, more tactical pace. Live-tunable: type `set sv_dmspeedmult 0.6` in the console to test without relaunching.
settings.label: Run speed multiplier
settings.name: sv_dmspeedmult

settings.description: prevent spamming (and certain command chains)
settings.label: Flood protection
settings.name: sv_floodProtect

settings.description: How many times a second the server simulates the world. The coop servers run 40.
settings.label: Server frames per second
settings.name: sv_fps

settings.description: invulnerable after respawning for x sec
settings.label: Respawn invulnerability (s)
settings.name: sv_invulnerabletime

settings.description: Zero MP bot cvars so they do not leak from a previous MP session. sv_maxbots is CVAR_LATCH (only takes effect next map load) but zeroing it here means the NEXT coop map after this one will have no bot slots, and sv_numbots is live so any bots from the current frame are shed at once.
settings.label: Max bots
settings.name: sv_maxbots

settings.description: 0 = uncapped. Set a real value only on a genuinely thin uplink.
settings.label: Max bytes/s per player (0 = no cap)
settings.name: sv_maxRate

settings.label: Bots fill server to this many
settings.name: sv_minPlayers

settings.description: pause between teacmchange
settings.label: Team change pause
settings.name: sv_team_spawn_interval

settings.description: 120 = the engine default, the same as hosting from the game. A player who is still loading a map sends nothing, so a very slow PC on a big map can need more. It cannot be switched off: 0 would drop everyone at once, and a crashed player's slot is only freed by this timer.
settings.label: Drop a player who sends nothing for (s)
settings.name: sv_timeout

settings.description: no timelimit
settings.label: Match time limit (min, 0 = off)
settings.name: timelimit
